knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r install, include=FALSE}

install.packages("soc.ca") 
install.packages("here") 
install.packages("haven") 
install.packages("sjlabelled")
```

```{r load, include=FALSE}

require(soc.ca)
require(here)
require(haven)
require(dplyr)
require(sjlabelled)
```

```{r data, include=FALSE}
data <- read_sav(here("Data", "Coursefile_Oslo_30var 1.sav"))

data <-  data %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.labelled), to_factor))

```

```{r construction_MCA}
data$ID <- 1:nrow(data)
active <- data.frame(data[,2:19])
id <- data.frame(data$ID)
sup <- data.frame(data$soctrust)
```

```{r}
SOC.MCA <- soc.mca(active, sup)

print(SOC.MCA)
```


```{r individuals}
which.max(abs(SOC.MCA$coord))))))
map.ind(SOC.MCA,)
```


```{r}
data.sub <- subset(data, ID!= 1228)

active <- data.frame(data.sub[,2:19])
sup <- data.frame(data.sub$soctrust)

SOC.MCA.sub <- soc.mca(active, sup)
```

```{r}
map.ind(SOC.MCA.sub)
```


```{r}
(output.ind <- map.ind(SOC.MCA.sub
                      , point.alpha = 0.3
                      , point.fill = "whitesmoke"
                      , point.color = "black"
                      , point.size = 0.5) +
  ylim(-2,2) +
  xlim(-2,2)
 )
```
